evidence.title: Open Targets drug profile: RETATRUTIDE
evidence.text: RETATRUTIDE is a Protein (ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5095485). Mechanisms of action: Glucagon receptor agonist (action type: AGONIST; target: Glucagon receptor); Glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonist (action type: AGONIST; target: Glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor); Gastric inhibitory polypeptide receptor agonist (action type: AGONIST; target: Gastric inhibitory polypeptide receptor). Indications recorded in Open Targets: none reported. Description: Protein drug with a maximum clinical stage of Phase 3 (across all indications), with 8 investigational indications.

evidence.title: Open Targets target profile: GCGR
evidence.text: Target GCGR (glucagon receptor), Ensembl ID ENSG00000215644. Function: G protein-coupled receptor for glucagon that plays a central role in the regulation of blood glucose levels and glucose homeostasis. Regulates the rate of hepatic glucose production by promoting glycogen hydrolysis and gluconeogenesis. Plays an important role in mediating the responses to fasting. Ligand binding causes a conformation change that triggers signaling via guanine nucleotide-binding proteins (G proteins) and modulates the activity of down-stream effectors, such as adenylate cyclase (PubMed:32193322, PubMed:38346960). Promotes activation of adenylate cyclase. Number of diseases associated with this target in Open Targets: 416. Top associated diseases: GCGR-related hyperglucagonemia (score 0.722); Hypoglycemia (score 0.589); diabetes mellitus (score 0.587); type 1 diabetes mellitus (score 0.553); type 2 diabetes mellitus (score 0.428); obesity disorder (score 0.419); metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (score 0.377); Overweight (score 0.371).
